final: WITH m AS (SELECT o.ordertune AS t, COUNT(*) AS c FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = r.ordervault GROUP BY o.ordertune), a AS (SELECT AVG(c) AS av FROM m WHERE c IS NOT NULL), k AS (SELECT m.c AS c, a.av AS av FROM m JOIN a ON a.av IS NOT NULL WHERE m.c > a.av) SELECT AVG(c) AS avg_count, AVG(c - av) AS avg_diff FROM k
